text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 2141599999 - p95 latency spike + error rate increase observed on inference-runtime. Hot path: KV cache read/write. Affected: rwd-open-13b-quantized-v2. Paging oncall @Dmitri K.

Dmitri K.: acked, joining. grabbing logs and router traces. anyone seeing customer tickets yet?

Emily R.: I see elevated 5xx for a few customers (enterprise-psi, shopwise). ETA to triage 3m.

Carla M.: @Emily R. assign a severity to customer impact? we need to consider mitigation if > 5% of requests failing.

Emily R.: initial assessment: ~6% of requests in the affected region got 502/504. Top caller: <api>/v1/generate (chat).

Ben L.: seeing KV cache hit ratio drop to near-zero for a subset of instances, memory churn high. probable KV deserialization regression after recent quant rollout.

Gina S.: rolling back quantized kernel might help. recommend disabling KV caching on the problematic model while we investigate.

Dmitri K.: agreed. performing live mitigation: 1) disable KV cache for rwd-open-13b-quantized-v2 2) reduce batcher max size to limit OOMs 3) rollback quant kernel if needed. will coordinate with deploy-bot.

Deploy-Bot: Rollout command accepted: initiating config change.

Dmitri K.: command to disable KV cache:
```
curl -XPOST https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/admin/cache/disable
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-quantized-v2","reason":"incident-2141599999"}'
```
Applying now.

Deploy-Bot: KV cache disabled for rwd-open-13b-quantized-v2 on pool-gamma.

Ben L.: after disabling cache, p95 dropped ~240ms -> ~90ms on affected nodes. errors down to ~1.2%. looks promising.

Emily R.: notifying support to update affected customer list and send interim notice. @Carla M. please prepare SLA impact summary.

Carla M.: will assemble. opening post-incident thread and scheduling review.

Dmitri K.: next step: try temporary batcher config change to reduce contention. applying:
```
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 8
  max_latency_ms: 50
```
Deployed to pool-gamma.

Ben L.: batcher change live. small tail improvements. no regressions observed so far.

Gina S.: since disabling KV cache masked error, root cause likely in cache serialization path introduced in the quantized-kernel PR. ticketing now.

Dmitri K.: creating immediate Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2141 (temp title: "KV cache deserialization errors after quant kernel rollout").

Carla M.: scheduling postmortem: proposed window T+24h at 11:00 PT. attendees: SRE, Runtime, ML-inference, Product, Support. will include customer impact slide and action items.

Dmitri K.: agreed. add engineering leads: @Ben L., @Gina S., @Emily R.

Ben L.: action items from live mitigation (assigning owners):
- Disable KV cache: Dmitri K. (done)
- Batcher throttle change: Ben L. (done)
- Rollback quant kernel for v2 if further regressions: Emily R. (on-standby)
- Postmortem doc + timeline: Carla M.
- Customer RPCs / support comms: Emily R.
- Add unit/regression tests for KV serialization: Gina S.

Carla M.: I'll create the postmortem doc in the incidents folder and add these as tracked action items with owners+due dates.

Dmitri K.: temporary mitigations stable for now. marking incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. moving to oncall handoff in 20m.

Emily R.: support: sent initial notices to affected accounts, will follow up with targeted post-incident email after triage.

Gina S.: quick note for root cause hypothesis: two simultaneous changes: quant kernel PR that altered tensor packing + a cache serialization optimization. combination seems to break older deserializers on a subset of instances. possible race with LRU eviction.

Ben L.: interim test checklist I'll add to the ticket:
- reproduce locally with quant v2 + KV load
- run deserialization fuzz tests
- confirm backwards compatibility on staged nodes
- perf/regression run before canary

Carla M.: Postmortem meeting scheduled: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/pm-2141599999. Doc draft created: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/2141599999 (please add notes + evidence).

Dmitri K.: handoff to next oncall @Emily R. I'll be available if needed for follow-ups.

Emily R.: taking over. thanks @Dmitri K. I'll watch the dashboards and consolidate the incident timeline for the postmortem.

Carla M.: action items + owners (formal):
- INF-2141: root cause investigation & replicable test cases -> Gina S. (due 5d)
- INF-2142: add KV serialization regression tests to CI -> Ben L. (due 7d)
- INF-2143: update runtime runbook with rollback steps & cache toggle -> Dmitri K. (due 3d)
- INF-2144: customer communication package & SLA calc -> Emily R. (due 2d)

Ben L.: adding note: consider a feature flag for new cache serialization to allow safe rollout.

Gina S.: will draft unit tests and a small canary plan.

Carla M.: closing on-call thread; formal postmortem thread will live under /incidents after the meeting. please add any missing facts here before I migrate. :thumbsup:

Emily R.: will add final customer impact numbers and attach logs.

incident-bot: Incident 2141599999 status updated -> MITIGATED -> MONITORING. Postmortem scheduled.

Dmitri K.: thanks everyone. good triage and quick mitigations.

Carla M.: thanks team. closing thread here.
